title: Review proposals (model output of /review Pass 1)
description: The only file the model writes in a /review run (spec 045 ADR-12). Every item names its sources; the source-in-period rule and the two-day rule for themes are checked by lib/review_doc.py against read.json. The habits group is computed by lib/review_habits.py and never appears here; the closed key set is also what keeps text for the user's own sections out (PRD F4-AC7).

language.description: The review language the proposals are written in (the setup's review.language).

text.description: The proposal in the review language; a second line becomes a continuation line of the item. Whitespace-only text is rejected (empty-text). A line starting with a heading, checkbox, quote, fence or thematic-break marker is rendered escaped, never as structure.

sources.description: Vault paths or stems of the notes the proposal rests on, as read.json lists them; at least one must be a daily of the period (a weekly note of the period for weekly_only). Only sources that resolve to such a note are rendered as links; any other source is dropped from the links.
